text:
maya: Quick check on one remaining thing for Autoscale compact: guardrail label and burst pill compact state. Fig: https://figma.redwood/infer/autoscale/compact-v4

harry: Vote: 'Recommended cap' for default. Less scary.

zeenat: Agree. Microcopy suggestion:
Min: Minimum GPUs kept online to meet latency targets.
Max: Max GPUs during spikes; may increase cost.
Guardrail (recommended): Helps keep traffic within SLO; excess may route to fallback capacity.

kai: Burst pill compact rule: for pools <=6 show absolute primary (+1 GPU) with muted percent below; >6 show percent primary (~+15%) with muted absolute on hover. Mobile: single-line percent preferred.

zeenat: Accessibility: ensure guardrail marker color meets AA at 12px (#8A4C00) and add aria-live text on slider change: "Min X GPUs. Max Y GPUs. Guardrail recommended at Z GPUs." Also roving tabindex for pool picker so Tab/Esc exit.

a11y-bot: Logged ACC-7001: autoscale-compact-guardrail + ACC-7002: pool-picker-roving. https://tracker.redwood/ACC-7001 https://tracker.redwood/ACC-7002

maya: Perfect. I'll update figma and push frames. Eng, please pick up INF-4102 for the adaptive label logic. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
